 Clusia is the first AI\-native assurance firm for companies that move money.
 




  






 We conduct the audits and independent testing fintechs, payments companies, and banks are required to complete each year — including annual ACH audits and BSA/AML testing.  We believe the next great assurance firm will be built like a software company. Clusia is building that firm — bringing more regulatory assurance under one roof and using technology to improve quality, increase auditor capacity, and deliver better economics for customers.

 We are looking for a small number of engineers to work closely with the CTO and our founding engineers.

 You won’t be handed a neatly scoped ticket queue. You’ll be expected to understand customer problems deeply, make good technical decisions in ambiguity, and build systems that can earn trust in a highly regulated environment.

 $125,000 \- $200,000 base salary \+ equity and benefits

* Collaborate with infrastructure, simulation, and data teams to accelerate robot learning research.

* Experience with at least one learning\-based robotics approach, such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning, diffusion policies, or VLA models.

* Experience designing and conducting experiments to evaluate learned policies.

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for an
 **Applied Scientist/Research Engineer** 
 to improve the quality of training data and evaluation systems used to develop advanced AI models.
   

  

 In this role, you will investigate how data quality, dataset composition, and evaluation methods influence model performance. You will design experiments, develop data curation and scoring methods, analyze model failures, and build tools that help us identify the data most valuable for training and improving AI systems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in applied ML research, data\-centric AI, or model evaluation who enjoys turning research insights into practical improvements.
   

  

****What You Will Own****
* Develop methods for training data curation, quality scoring, dataset selection, and data mixing.
* Design evaluation frameworks and benchmarks to measure model capabilities and identify performance gaps.
* Analyze model failures to understand how training data affects model behavior and generalization.
* Apply techniques such as active learning and human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation to improve data efficiency and annotation quality.
* Build automated tools and pipelines to improve data quality while reducing annotation costs and manual effort.
* Design and run experiments to measure how data improvements translate into better model performance.
* Collaborate with research, engineering, and data operations teams to turn findings into scalable solutions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience in applied ML research, data science, AI evaluation, or a related technical field.
* Strong Python skills and experience with relevant ML frameworks and data processing tools.
* Experience with one or more of the following: training data curation, dataset optimization, model evaluation, benchmark development, active learning, or post\-training.
* Strong experimental design and analytical skills, with the ability to connect data characteristics to model performance.
* Experience developing technical solutions, research methods, or automated pipelines rather than only performing annotation or data labeling.
* Ability to communicate research findings clearly and translate them into actionable improvements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience at AI data or model development companies (ex. Scale AI, Mercor, Surge AI, or similar organizations).
* Experience improving model performance through better training data or dataset composition.
* Experience building evaluation frameworks or analyzing model failures.
* Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop systems, annotation quality measurement, or data selection algorithms.
* Research publications or demonstrated applied research contributions are a plus.

**The Role**
 Triumph ships a lot of cards. Behind that is a warehouse, a network of vendors, and hundreds of people running processes that should be automated. This team builds the software that makes all of it work, and we are hiring an engineer to help us scale it.
   

  

 You will be on a team of five building the software behind Triumph's physical card business: the portal vendors sell to us through, the dashboard that tracks our inventory, computer vision that identifies cards, and the tools Ops uses to audit and ship from our warehouse. You'll work full stack across our Go backend, React frontend, and React Native mobile apps.
   

  

 This team sits closer to the physical cards than any other engineering team at Triumph. Every card we buy, vault, and ship moves through software you'll build. A problem Ops flags in the morning often has a fix by the afternoon. You can walk to the Ops floor and watch it get used the same day. Please note this role is located in Mountain View, and will most likely be moving to Fremont, CA in the near future.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build and scale the tooling that runs logistics: vendor intake, validation, fulfillment, and third party logistics integrations.
* Automate manual operations processes, working alongside mechanical engineering, to increase how much Triumph can ship.
* Extend our computer vision system for identifying cards from a photograph, expanding it beyond its current scope to additional trading card games.
* Build event and experiential tools, like the iPad pack rip we ran at Collect\-A\-Con, and help shape what comes next. This is an area where we want your ideas as much as your code.
* Own and improve the internal dashboard and other internal tooling as the team's scope grows.
* Work across the whole stack. We also maintain a few iOS apps, which the team built along the way.


**What We're Looking For**
* 1\-5 years of full stack web development experience.
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Projects here are defined loosely and you will shape them.
* Fluency with AI as a tool, never as a substitute for understanding. You use it aggressively and can explain every line that ships under your name.
* Willingness to work on site most days, where the operation actually happens.


**Why Triumph?**
* High growth. Build the platform under a high\-scale consumer product that touches gaming, finance, and social, with 16x year\-over\-year growth.
* High agency. We let builders build. Blast radius is contained by modularity and feature flags, not by process and approval gates. Small team, real ownership, significant room for leadership.
* High stakes. Real money moves through your systems every minute. The work is visible, and it matters.
* Competitive salary and benefits. $400/mo lunch credit, healthcare, vision, dental, 401k, etc.
* In person. Our team gathers 5 days a week.

 The University of Miami/UHealth Department of Public Health has an exciting opportunity for a full time Data Analyst 3 to work in Miami, FL.
   

  

 The Department of Public Health Sciences at the University of Miami has an opportunity for a Data Analyst 3 to serve as a senior research data systems specialist supporting complex, longitudinal, multi\-site, and multi\-arm epidemiologic and clinical research studies. The position will support state\-, federally\-, and institutionally funded research programs, including large\-scale occupational and environmental health studies involving firefighters and other first responder populations. The Data Analyst 3 will serve as a subject matter expert in REDCap and related research data technologies and will work closely with principal investigators, biostatisticians, epidemiologists, research coordinators, project managers, and other research personnel to design, develop, implement, and maintain sophisticated electronic data capture and research data management systems.
   

  

 The position requires advanced expertise in REDCap, including longitudinal project architecture, repeated instruments and events, automated workflows, complex branching and calculated fields, survey administration, data quality procedures, user rights and security, application programming interfaces, and integration with external data sources and analytic systems. The incumbent will also have substantial experience with MyCap and the REDCap Mobile App and will support participant\-facing and field\-based mobile data collection. The Data Analyst 3 will use R and/or Python to develop reproducible data processing workflows, automate data extraction and transformation, interface with REDCap APIs, conduct data quality assessments, prepare complex longitudinal analytic datasets, and support research analyses and reporting. This position is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement, with remote work combined with periodic on\-site meetings, project planning, training, and collaborative activities as required.
   

  

 Core Job Functions:
   

  

* Performs advanced data analysis using various techniques, e.g. statistical analysis, explanatory and predictive modeling, data mining.
* Determines best practices and develops actionable insights and recommendations for the current business operations or issues.
* Performs ad\-hoc analyses and reporting, to aid management in the decision\-making process. Builds dashboards or reporting systems for end users, and designs predictive modeling or other data mining capabilities.
* Designs and develops complex databases and dashboards data to optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
* Provides advanced business data interpretation, such as identifying trends or patterns of complex data sets. May handle special analytical projects as needed.
* Provides support and training to applicable staff regarding data management and use.
* Locate and define new process improvement opportunities; proactively identify opportunities to enhance data collection, quality and accessibility.
* Develops and implements systems to capture business operation information.
* Acts as a subject matter expert and advises less experienced analysts.
* Locates and defines new process improvement opportunities; proactively identifies opportunities to enhance data collection, quality and accessibility.
* Defines data elements and establishes policies and procedures related to the collection, accuracy, quality, security, and maintenance of data.
* Adheres to University and unit\-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets.


**Department Specific Functions:**
* Serves as the principal REDCap subject matter expert for assigned research programs and provides advanced technical consultation regarding REDCap architecture, functionality, data management, and research workflows.
* Designs, develops, tests, implements, and maintains complex REDCap projects supporting longitudinal, multi\-arm, multi\-site, repeated\-measures, observational, and interventional research studies.
* Develops sophisticated longitudinal REDCap structures, including arms, events, repeated instruments, repeating events, participant schedules, automated survey invitations, alerts and notifications, calculated fields, branching logic, action tags, and complex participant follow\-up workflows.
* Develops and maintains REDCap application programming interface integrations and automated workflows for secure exchange of data between REDCap and external research, analytic, laboratory, biospecimen, administrative, or other authorized systems.
* Uses R and/or Python to interact programmatically with REDCap APIs, automate data extraction and transformation, perform data validation and quality\-control procedures, create reproducible data pipelines, and prepare research datasets for statistical analysis.
* Develops and supports MyCap projects for participant\-facing longitudinal data collection, including configuration of participant tasks, questionnaires, scheduled assessments, notifications, and data synchronization with REDCap.
* Develops and supports REDCap Mobile App workflows for field\-based and offline research data collection and assists research teams with deployment, synchronization, quality assurance, and troubleshooting.
* Designs electronic case report forms, questionnaires, surveys, participant tracking systems, screening tools, recruitment databases, retention systems, and other electronic research instruments.
* Develops and maintains data dictionaries, metadata, codebooks, standard operating procedures, technical documentation, system specifications, and data\-management documentation for research studies.
* Conducts advanced quality assurance and quality\-control activities to identify missing, inconsistent, duplicate, implausible, or otherwise problematic research data and develops automated or semi\-automated procedures for detecting and resolving data\-quality issues.
* Develops reproducible data\-management workflows for longitudinal research datasets involving multiple study visits, repeated measures, study arms, participant groups, data sources, and follow\-up periods.
* Integrates data from multiple research sources, which may include REDCap, MyCap, mobile applications, wearable devices, environmental monitoring instruments, laboratory systems, biospecimen repositories, administrative datasets, and external research databases.
* Designs and maintains automated data pipelines to support secure and efficient transfer, transformation, harmonization, and preparation of research data.
* Prepares analysis\-ready datasets and works collaboratively with investigators and biostatisticians to define variables, derive analytic measures, establish longitudinal data structures, and document data transformations.
* Conducts statistical programming and exploratory, descriptive, and other analyses using R and/or Python, as appropriate to project needs.
* Develops dashboards, automated reports, recruitment and retention reports, data\-quality reports, study monitoring tools, and other decision\-support products for investigators and research teams.
* Supports data harmonization across multiple studies and develops standardized variables, naming conventions, coding practices, and reusable data structures when appropriate.
* Establishes and maintains appropriate REDCap user roles, data access groups, permissions, authentication procedures, and data\-security configurations consistent with institutional and study requirements.
* Ensures research data systems and workflows are developed and maintained in accordance with approved protocols, IRB requirements, HIPAA requirements when applicable, data\-use agreements, institutional policies, and human\-subjects research protections.
* Provides advanced REDCap, MyCap, mobile data collection, API, and research data\-management training and technical support to investigators, coordinators, analysts, students, and other research personnel.
* Troubleshoots complex REDCap, MyCap, API, mobile application, and data\-management issues and works with institutional REDCap administrators and other information technology personnel when escalation is required.
* Evaluates emerging REDCap functionality, external modules, APIs, research data technologies, and analytic tools and recommends solutions that improve data quality, efficiency, scalability, and reproducibility.
* Develops reusable programming functions, scripts, templates, and automated workflows to standardize research data\-management activities across studies.
* Participates in study planning and protocol development by advising research teams regarding data architecture, electronic data capture, participant\-facing technology, study workflows, data integration, and analytic feasibility.
* Supports preparation of manuscripts, abstracts, presentations, grant applications, progress reports, and other scholarly products through data management, analysis, visualization, and interpretation.
* Advises and mentors research staff and less experienced analysts regarding REDCap development, research data management, programming, and data\-quality best practices.
* Maintains appropriate technical documentation and version\-controlled programming code to promote reproducibility, continuity, and transparency of research data workflows.
* Performs other data analysis, programming, research informatics, and research data\-management duties as assigned.


**This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.**
**Core Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, information systems, biostatistics, bioinformatics, public health, epidemiology, health informatics, statistics, mathematics, or a related field. Preferred: Master's degree in data science, biostatistics, epidemiology, public health, health informatics, computer science, bioinformatics, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.

Job Description:
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a Research Engineer to build simulation environments, training workflows, and evaluation systems for embodied AI and robotics.
   

  

 You will help create the virtual environments and tools that enable robotic policies to be trained, tested, and evaluated at scale before being deployed in the real world. Depending on your expertise, you may focus on simulation\-based policy training and evaluation, or on scene reconstruction and synthetic data generation.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer with strong simulation or robotics experience who enjoys building technically grounded environments that support real learning and measurable improvements in robotic performance.
   

  

****What You Will Own****
* Build and maintain simulation environments for robot learning, training, and evaluation.
* Develop robotic tasks, environments, reward functions, and evaluation metrics.
* Work with platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, or similar simulation frameworks.
* Support simulation\-based policy training and automated evaluation at scale.
* Implement domain randomization and other techniques to improve policy robustness and sim\-to\-real transfer.
* Develop sensor simulation, synthetic data generation, or scene reconstruction workflows as relevant to your specialization.
* Validate simulation results against real\-world robot behavior and investigate discrepancies.
* Build reusable simulation tools and pipelines that improve experiment reproducibility and research efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience in robotics simulation, robotics research, simulation\-based training, or a related technical field.
* Strong Python programming skills and familiarity with relevant robotics or simulation tools.
* Experience with at least one simulation platform, such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, or an equivalent framework.
* Understanding of robotic systems, 3D environments, physics simulation, or learning\-based robotics.
* Experience building functional simulation environments, training workflows, evaluation pipelines, or synthetic data systems.
* Strong debugging and experimental skills, with the ability to validate whether simulation results reflect meaningful real\-world behavior.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience training or evaluating robotic policies in simulation.
* Experience with domain randomization, sim\-to\-real transfer, or sensor simulation.
* Experience with scene reconstruction, synthetic data generation, or physically grounded 3D environment creation.
* Experience building reusable tools for large\-scale simulation or automated evaluation.
* Experience comparing simulation results with real\-world robot performance.


**Note:** 
 Candidates may specialize in either simulation\-based policy training and evaluation or scene reconstruction and synthetic data generation. Experience across both areas is not required. However, candidates should demonstrate technical depth beyond visual scene creation alone.

* Health insurance
* Vision care
* Dental coverage
* 401(k)
* Paid holidays
* PTO (Paid Time Off)
* Sick leave

 The future of defense will be decided by those who field intelligent machines at scale. At Scout AI, we’re developing Fury, the first robotic foundation model for defense, to give U.S. forces overwhelming, adaptable, and autonomous power across every domain. Fury enables human operators to command fleets of robots through natural language, and empowers those machines to sense, decide, and act together as one. This mission will ask everything of us: urgency, precision, and relentless work.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who treats the code itself as the product. You’ll join the core software team at Scout AI and work across the systems Fury runs on: the onboard C\+\+ code and core libraries, the cloud infrastructure that trains and evaluates the model, and the simulation and evals framework that tells us whether any of it works.
   

  

 A lot of this job is hardening. As our platform rapidly scales, our senior engineers actively drive architectural stewardship \- continually refining abstractions, hardening core systems, and evolving our software foundation to support our accelerated growth. We want someone who can take that on: read a large codebase, understand it, spot the anti\-patterns, and restructure it well.
   

  

 The same person should be comfortable building the test and validation systems that let the rest of the team move faster. We aren’t hiring for one narrow specialty. Depending on where you’re strongest, you might spend most of your time onboard C\+\+, in GPU job infrastructure and cloud services, or in simulation and evaluation tooling. What’s common across all of it is a background building frameworks and libraries that other systems depend on, rather than applications on top of someone else’s framework. We use AI coding tools and expect you to as well, but we think of them as a multiplier on skills you already have. You should be able to write, explain, and debug your own code without them.
   

  

 We’re a startup. You’ll be moving fast, context\-switching daily, and helping define the culture and process as we go. This is a rare opportunity to come in early and architect the future of defense.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain onboard C\+\+ software and core system libraries
* Build scalable, low\-latency C\+\+ and Python infrastructure for ML workloads
* Design cloud systems for data storage and GPU job scheduling
* Build simulation and evaluation pipelines, including synthetic agents, rendering tools, and scenario suites
* Create evaluation criteria and internal tooling to analyze and compare software release builds
* Refactor existing codebases to eliminate anti\-patterns and improve system architecture
* Construct data pipelines for sensor calibration and 3D reconstruction workflows
* Implement automated test and validation frameworks across subsystem engineering teams


**Qualification**
* Proficient in C\+\+ or Python (either is fine) for core systems, simulation, evaluation, and tooling work
* Demonstrated experience navigating, auditing, and refactoring large codebases
* Track record of building shared software frameworks or underlying libraries
* Ability to write, debug, and explain complex code independently without relying on AI tools
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities
* Passion about defense of the United States and its allies
* May be expected to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance


**Nice to Have**
* Cloud and infrastructure experience (GPU job scheduling, service deployment)
* Simulation or evals background
* Calibration or 3D reconstruction experience
* Edge or embedded hardware familiarity

* Work on the world’s most important frontier, ensuring U.S. and allied dominance in the age of intelligent machines
* Be a core part of a team building the first defense\-specific robotic foundation model
* Collaborate with some of the top engineers in autonomy, AI, and national security

**Description**
 Do you want to build the infrastructure that every AWS service depends on before it can start? The AWS Secrets Management team builds and operates the system that distributes credentials and certificates to AWS's internal service fleet. The system sits on the critical path for service startup, runs across every host in the fleet, and has zero tolerance for downtime. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and deliver backend services, APIs, and the host agent that powers credential distribution at massive scale. You will also lead migrations that modernize how credentials are stored and delivered, build AI\-agent\-driven operational tooling, and help bring the system up in new AWS regions. If you are a self\-starter who thrives on solving hard distributed\-systems problems with real, immediate impact, this is the role for you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implement production backend services, APIs, and host\-level agents in Java, Rust, C\+\+, and Python that distribute credentials and certificates across AWS's internal fleet with high availability and zero downtime.
* Own end\-to\-end migrations of live, heavily depended\-upon systems, preserving backwards compatibility while modernizing how credentials are stored and delivered.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated test coverage, and AI\-assisted operational tooling — including agentic coding tools for triage and remediation — to keep a fleet\-wide system operable at scale.
* Collaborate with security partner teams, product managers, and principal engineers on cross\-team designs, participating in written design reviews and code reviews to ensure solutions meet security and reliability requirements.
* Drive operational excellence through metrics, alarms, incident response, and on\-call rotations, identifying root causes and implementing permanent fixes to reduce operational burden over time.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Most of your time is heads\-down: writing code, reviewing designs, and working through complex migration plans for systems that thousands of other services depend on. Collaboration is concentrated at key moments — design reviews where you present your approach, code reviews where you give and receive candid feedback, and incident response where your deep knowledge of the system makes you the person others turn to. You use AI\-assisted engineering tools daily, both for coding and for operational triage, applying your judgment on when to trust their output.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Secrets Management team is responsible for credential and certificate distribution across AWS's internal service fleet. Our system is a dependency for a large number of AWS and Amazon services, which means the work we do is upstream of other teams' launches, migrations, and security commitments. We operate in an inclusive environment that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Engineers each own an area of the system outright — serving as the required reviewer, the go\-to person during incidents, and the one who sets its technical direction. We are focused on modernizing credential delivery and expanding into new AWS regions, and we are looking for engineers who are excited to shape that future.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience
* 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

* Professional experience in security engineering, fuzzing, detection and response, or other applied defensive work.
* Experience participating in or building CTF competitions and cyber ranges.
* Academic research experience in cybersecurity.
* Familiarity with RL techniques and environments.
* Familiarity with LLM training methodologies.

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

Analyzes credit information to support lending decisions and processes for new and existing Commercial banking loans and credit solutions in an assigned portfolio of clients. Makes credit decisions and recommendations in compliance with bank policies and procedures while maintaining an exceptional client service environment.
   

  

* Performs financial analysis and calculations, assesses client creditworthiness, prepares detailed credit summaries, analyses financial performance and risk profiles of clients within the portfolio.
* Supports credit\-granting decisions by making recommendations to manager
* Supports the negotiation of loan terms and conditions and the structuring of loans that align with client requirements and ensure compliance with the banks risk appetite and policies.
* Supports portfolio monitoring and compliance, analyses metrics, and assesses industry trends to spot risks and opportunities.
* Develops proposals to capture new business and expand client relationships.
* Monitors loan performance, accuracy and integrity of loan documentation and addresses credit\-related issues while ensuring the accuracy and integrity of loan documentation.
* Builds and maintains client relationships to ensure long\-term financial performance in collaboration with Relationship Manager and business partners.
* Structures and supports new, renewal and extension loans aligned with client needs and bank \& risk policies
* Conducts financial analysis and risk assessments of clients’ credit information, for an assigned portfolio, to provide insights and make informed decisions
* Monitors the portfolio performance for assigned portfolio of Commercial Banking clients on an ongoing basis, taking corrective action when required.
* Minimizes BMO’s risk exposure by adhering to credit policies, regulatory standards, and operational guidelines.
* Serves as a point of contact for service requests, ensuring expectations are consistently met or exceeded. Escalates issues when needed.
* Supports and implements initiatives to enhance service quality, acquire new business and expand client relationships.
* Identifies revenue and cross\-selling opportunities to enhance portfolio growth.
* Identifies share of wallet opportunities.
* Leverages analysis tools to nurture and grow a portfolio that exceeds ROE thresholds and evaluates client returns on a proactive basis.
* Manages timely and accurate data entry into BMO's systems and leverages the data to support decision\-making.
* Focus may be on a business/group.
* Thinks creatively and proposes new solutions.
* Exercises judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems within given rules.
* Works mostly independently.
* Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
* Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.
   

  

**Qualifications:**
* Preferred 1 – 3 years of relevant experience in credit or lending instruments or financial operations in a corporate or banking environment.
* If a Credit Qualifiable job, Credit Qualifications and associated credit knowledge and skills according to the credit portfolio requirements and qualification standards.
* Bachelor’s degree required; Business Administration, Finance and Accounting preferred. Any other related discipline or commensurate work experience considered.
* Specialized knowledge from education and/or business experience.
